Title: General availability: Azure Cache for Redis with Web App Marketplace offer

Body.Content:
Quickly create an Azure Cache for Redis instance as part of a secure environment with a Web App and a database to host performance optimized web applications. The Azure Marketplace offer enables you to start with a lower cost deployment and scale up later based on your application’s needs. Your application can start consuming the cache instance right away from the automatically configured connectivity. Quickly start applying performance enhancements, such as the Cache-Aside pattern with Azure Cache for Redis, to your web applications. 

Learn more.
